evidence_sentence: The test is marked as disabled due to its flaky nature, as noted in the comment referencing a bug report.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation conditionally maps the password-settings test name to DISABLED_TestSettingsFramePasswords on Windows because of the cited flakiness, whereas the fixed implementation defines an enabled TestSettingsFramePasswords test and contains no disabling macro or flaky-test rationale. The docstring presents this vulnerable-version-specific test disabling as normal behavior.
rewritten_docstring: The code includes a browser test for the Chrome settings passwords frame. It constructs a URL pointing to the Chrome settings page specifically for passwords by appending "passwords" to the base URL `chrome::kChromeUISettingsFrameURL`. The function `RunBidiCheckerOnPage` is then called with this URL to perform the bidi checking operation.
